content: {"like":["Spectacular first season that raised the stakes for superhero TV shows","Second season was just as good for most of its running time","Good writing in the first two seasons","Nice action scenes","Acting ranges from adequate to great, especially Tom Cavannagh who is exceptional"],"dislike":["Poor writing quality in third season, especially towards the end","Severe drop in writing quality in a particular episode","Lack of respect for continuity, rules broken and mangled","Characters act as the plot demands rather than their personalities","Heroes unable to learn lessons and keep committing mistakes","Characterization comes and goes, some characters overused or underused","Adaptations of popular villains devoid of what makes them interesting","Main villain of the season is boring, uninteresting, and visually unappealing","Overall issues prevent enjoying the show"]}
